**Finding: compliant (preferred position met).**

- **§ 12.3 (p0051)** expressly preserves Customer's freedom: "Nothing restricts Customer from developing, acquiring, licensing, selling, or using any product or service, engaging any supplier…" and confirms "Customer has made no exclusivity, non-compete, most-favoured-customer, minimum-volume, or no-hire commitment."
- **§ 2.1 (p0013)** reinforces this: no minimum quantity or purchase commitment, and declining further Order Forms is not a breach.
- All other "exclusive" hits are unrelated (non-exclusive licence to Customer in § 13.1; exclusive-remedy and exclusive-jurisdiction mechanics in §§ 19, 21, 28.2, 30).
- **§ 12.4** restricts Vendor from marketing a competing analytics service — exclusivity in *our* favour, which the playbook treats as acceptable and which we should not disturb.

No redline proposed.
